title: (RHEA-2018:1317) RHEA: gluster-colonizer enhancement update
portal_summary: Updated gluster-colonizer packages are now available to support Red Hat Storage One 1.0 for Red Hat Gluster Storage 3.3.
portal_product_filter: Red Hat Gluster Storage|Red Hat Gluster Storage Server for On-premise|3|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
Red Hat Storage One enables fast deployment of Red Hat Gluster Storage for specific workloads using specific pre-validated hardware. Deployment using Red Hat Storage One is faster, follows recommended practices, and provides optimal performance for the hardware and workload used.

The gluster-colonizer package provides the Colonizer tool for installation and configuration functionality. The gluster-zeroconf package provides automatic discovery of Red Hat Gluster Storage nodes to support the Colonizer. The fio package provides I/O testing capabilities to support performance testing following deployment.

This update contains the following enhancement:

* The Colonizer tool now supports client storage access via SMB with CTDB, plus optional Active Directory integration. (BZ#1563582)

These updated packages are pre-installed on hardware that is pre-validated for use with Red Hat Storage One.
